content:
Apple today officially unveiled the long-awaited iPhone Duo, its first foldable iPhone. After the event, I spent a few minutes hands-on with the device, and here's what it looks like in the real world.

The iPhone Duo features a 7.6-inch Super Retina XDR inner display and a 5.4-inch outer display. The inner display uses a nano-texture matte finish that helps reduce the visibility of the crease and reflections. After testing it, I found the effect quite good — the crease was hard to detect from most angles. The hinge design is also impressive.

The iPhone Duo is stunning both in person and in today's event video, with a very futuristic feel, like an engineering marvel. This form factor will open up a wealth of innovative use cases for both productivity and entertainment. The software experience is also excellent, with the standout being the progressive blur transition effect when opening and closing the phone.

There's plenty more analysis of today's Apple event coming later. The iPhone Duo will be available for pre-order starting October 16, with general availability on October 23. Pricing starts at $1,999 for the 256GB model.
